Hello Sakari﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P7 170000763
ChargerID/Serial No.
: JKAD6V
Problem Description
: Contactor errors and Dispenser selftest fail
Troubleshooting
:
For the QA13-14 it occurred 13 times since last month. It's a small ammount but since the charger is very far from your workplace/home, we should replace it.
For the QA19-20 please proceed with the replacement as we had 400 instances last month.
For the Dispenser error flag:
Early warning of possible Dispenser PLC cooling fans malfunctioning
Note: The self-test is performed at each boot-up of the dispenser where the cooling fans are power-cycled on-off from dispenser-PLC for multiple times in short duration cycles. If the ok signal reported by fan is lost even after a delay of ON command to the fan, it denotes self test error
possible solutions:
check electrical wiring of cooling circuit for tightness.
check if cooling air filters are clean and not blocking
perform preventive maintenance and check by multiple reboots if the self test is failing, then it could be early sign that the cooling fan may fail later and it is recommended to start thinking about spares
For this I believe we need to test several times rebooting the charger and see when it happens, from what I usually see, it's always after a reboot.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0367733
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
